envelope.description: Add code-review admission and resource-guard contracts

body.title: Add code-review admission and resource-guard contracts
body.summary: Introduce the approved unverified admission variant and bounded shared resource-guard types (proposed src/shared/review-resources.ts), then update code-review checkpoint codecs/discriminating readers. Keep historical qualified records readable and current routes safe; production does not emit the new variant until worker cutover.
acceptanceChecks: Code admission is a distinct unverified variant with exact immutable input and no invented selected tasks, accepted scope or approval binding.
Code checkpoint readers round-trip historical qualified attempts and refuse unknown versions; changed pinned input is rejected and admission failures/interruption retain explicit attempt semantics.
Shared resourceGuard/open-lease/clearance receipt shapes are bounded, exact-review scoped and ready for serialized family checkpoint writes; unresolved leases cannot be truncated.
All affected code consumers compile and fail safely on unqualified admission; existing source-pin and completion checks remain mandatory.

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/admission-checkpoint.test.ts: unverified admission and resource guards preserve pinned code history and refuse approval
src/shared/__tests__/review-resources.test.ts: bounded exact review lease and clearance receipt contracts reject invalid input
